problem_meta.agent_answer:
## Functional summary

The 534-aa protein is an **alkaline/neutral invertase** (**EC 3.2.1.26**), corresponding to the reviewed *Arabidopsis thaliana* protein **UniProt F4I2X9**. The supplied sequence is an **exact sequence match** to this reference, so the assignment is strongly supported by curated annotation rather than distant homology alone.

### Catalyzed reaction

\[
\text{sucrose} + \mathrm{H_2O}
\rightarrow
\text{D-glucose} + \text{D-fructose}
\]

The enzyme hydrolyzes the **terminal non-reducing β-D-fructofuranoside linkage** of sucrose. It is therefore a **glycoside hydrolase/invertase**, likely functioning in the cytosol or other alkaline-to-neutral cellular compartment.

The reaction annotation and substrate/product specificity are supported by the reviewed, exact-match UniProt record.
